newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE coffee heads down in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE coffee heads down in thin trade.

text.p: LIFFE robusta coffee futures nudged down in an another extremely subdued trade at midsession on Friday with the only interest centred on nearby July/Sept switches.
The spread widened to $20 at the midday pause from $6 at Thursday's close, as players rolled out of the July position ahead of the first notice day on Tuesday.
The market was called $100 lower on numbers after the steep losses in New York on Thursday. But September gapped just $31 down at the open and finished the morning business $41 lower at $1,760.
New York coffee futures ended sharply lower and toward the bottom of the day's range on Thursday, pounded by chart-driven speculative and local selling.
No damaging cold is in sight for Brazil's coffee-growing areas for the next five days, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said on Friday.
"The main danger now is that it is so warm that the predicted rains could actually lead to flowerings three months ahead of normal," broker GNI said.
One trader said: "It looks like a one-way street for coffee now. It's very difficult to be bullish."
